name: Mikhail
source:
Height: 5'11"
Magic: Dark

An arcane scholar and a master in the lost art of necromancy; Mikhail seeks Rune out in hopes that they can exchange magical knowledge.

He is alluring and polite, but can also be a bit creepy. He enjoys teasing Rune.
